bio.text: Karen Ortiz is running as an independent candidate for New York's 12th Congressional District in 2026, her first run for elected office, according to a March 2026 West Side Rag profile.

The profile says she was an administrative judge at the Equal Employment Opportunity Commission's New York District Office, and that her earlier legal career included the NYC Parks Department, the Taxi and Limousine Commission and disability litigation for the Social Security Administration.
She was born in Manhattan and graduated from Columbia College and Fordham Law School, according to the profile.

sources.title: Meet Karen Ortiz, an Independent Candidate Running to Represent the UWS in Congress
